security.title: Two-step verification
security.hint: An extra layer of protection: besides your password, signing in needs a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…).
security.step2: 2. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
security.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
security.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:
security.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
security.codesHint: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only here, only now — keep them somewhere safe.
security.disableHint: Your account will be protected by your password alone.
security.newCodesHint: The old codes will stop working.

errors.invalid_code: Wrong code. Try a fresh one from the app.

linked.title: Linked sign-ins
linked.hint: Other ways to sign in to this account. Remove any you don't recognise.
linked.removeBody: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in to this account through Google.
linked.lastMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password first (use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page).

security.step1NoPassword: 1. Confirm it's you (you signed up with Google, so we email you a code)
